prompt: Keep only the first-ranked row of each group.
template:
-- EXPECTED: [["analytics", "orders", 210], ["archive", "audit", 10], ["billing", "orders", 200], ["fraud", "orders", 80], ["zeta", "orders", 40]]

-- Tables are loaded for you: partitions(topic, partition_id, log_end_offset) and commits(group_id, topic, partition_id, committed_offset).
SELECT group_id, topic, committed_offset FROM (
  SELECT group_id, topic, committed_offset,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY group_id ORDER BY committed_offset DESC) AS rn
  FROM commits
)
@@BLANK@@
ORDER BY group_id;
why: Filtering rn = 1 keeps only the top row of each group.
